scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs
